desc: Ideation and algorithm selection: corrected one-state bottom-up DP with modulo-forced open path lengths.
Implement the full corrected bottom-up greedy DP solution as described, including iterative traversal and O(NK) time/memory.

Verify implementation on sample tests and edge cases: K=1, K=2 perfect matching, single path of K vertices, star with K vertices, deep chain, root with zero positive children, more than two positive children, and impossible modulo cases.
